title: _initterm, _initterm_e | Microsoft Learn
paraphrase: The two pointer parameters delimit a function-pointer table. The CRT uses these routines during C++ initialization and ignores null table entries.
use: The Original PE imports _initterm and its startup body passes a range containing the Stitch initializer. Applying the documented CRT contract explains the startup initialization route, conditional on execution reaching that call and prior initialization completing normally.
limits: The loaded CRT implementation and actual process execution were not captured or executed. The study does not prove invocation on every possible process startup or the current live table contents.
